meaning_en: the feeling of eagerly expecting something
quote: Grow tumescent with anticipation.
quote_cn: 带着期待肿胀起来。
example: The deal closed a month earlier than anyone had anticipated.
example_cn: 交易比所有人预期的早一个月敲定。
note: 形容词 anticipated。动词 anticipate。

meaning_en: generally believed to be, though not proven
quote: Reputed to have whacked one " Dog" Paulson
quote_cn: 据称砍过一个绰号「狗」的保罗森。
example: He is the reputed owner of the chain, though no records confirm it.
example_cn: 据称他是这家连锁的老板，但没有任何记录能证实。
note: ≈ alleged（法律新闻用 alleged）。名词 reputation 声誉。

meaning_en: a subordinate who carries out a boss's orders
quote: This is one of Tuco's henchmen.
quote_cn: 这是 Tuco 的一个马仔。
example: Every racket boss needs a henchman to watch the door.
example_cn: 每个江湖大佬都得有个马仔看门。
note: 近义 goon、muscle。带贬义。

meaning_en: an organized group controlling a trade, often illegally
meaning_cn: 卡特尔（垄断集团）；贩毒集团
quote: El Paso says he's got some kind of cartel connection.
quote_cn: 埃尔帕斯奥说他们跟某个卡特尔有关系。
example: Prosecutors described the firm as a cartel that fixed prices.
example_cn: 检方把这家公司描述成操纵价格的卡特尔。
note: 经济学正式义＝卡特尔；新闻义常指贩毒集团。

meaning_en: property offered as security for a debt
quote: There's always a lot of collateral.
quote_cn: 抵押品总是很多。
example: The bank wants collateral before it releases the funds.
example_cn: 银行要求先有抵押才放款。
note: ≈ security。动词 collateralize。

meaning_en: a group of people working together
quote: Picked up my whole crew, top to bottom.
quote_cn: 把我整伙人从上到下全端了。
example: She assembled a small crew to run the pilot.
example_cn: 她组了一个小班子来运营这个试点。
note: 职场中性；犯罪语境＝一伙。a film crew＝摄制组。

meaning_en: visibly upset and restless
quote: When he came home last night, he was agitated, upset.
quote_cn: 他昨晚回到家时情绪很激动，很不安。
example: The caller became agitated and hung up.
example_cn: 对方情绪激动起来，就把电话挂了。
note: 动词 agitate。名词 agitation。

meaning_en: socially quiet and uninvolved
quote: He's been withdrawn lately.
quote_cn: 他最近越来越封闭自己。
example: He grew withdrawn after the move.
example_cn: 搬走以后他变得很孤僻。
note: ＝ introverted。动词 withdraw＝退出／取款。

meaning_en: the way two things affect each other
quote: there's no drug interactions
quote_cn: 没有药物相互作用。
example: Check for interactions before you combine two prescriptions.
example_cn: 合并两种处方药前先查相互作用。
note: 动词 interact。形容词 interactive ＝ 互动的。

meaning_en: a building where dead bodies are kept
quote: Every morgue.
quote_cn: 每一家太平间。
example: They checked every morgue within fifty miles.
example_cn: 他们查了五十英里内每一家太平间。
note: 读 /ˈmɔːrɡ/，结尾 -gue 不发音。

meaning_en: a name used instead of one's real name
quote: Heisenberg is kind of a pseudonym.
quote_cn: Heisenberg 算是个化名。
example: She published her first book under a pseudonym.
example_cn: 她的第一本书是用化名出版的。
note: 形容词 pseudonymous。反义 real name。近义 alias。

meaning_en: police surveillance aircraft
quote: They got ghetto birds and black ops.
quote_cn: 他们出动了警用直升机和特勤。
example: Two ghetto birds circled the property for an hour.
example_cn: 两架警用直升机绕着房产转了一个小时。
note: 俚语。ghetto 在此指警区，非贫民区义。

meaning_en: to forcibly move from a place or way of life
meaning_cn: 连根拔起；彻底改变生活
quote: I can't just uproot my life like that.
quote_cn: 我不能就这样把生活连根拔起。
example: The merger uprooted him from a team he'd been on for a decade.
example_cn: 那次合并把他从待了十年的团队里连根拔走了。
note: 名词 uprooting。反义 put down roots（扎根）。

meaning_en: to steal
quote: First you boost it, then you leave it in your house.
quote_cn: 你先把它偷了，然后就把它撂在你家里。
example: Someone boosted the delivery van overnight.
example_cn: 有人一夜之间把送货车偷了。
note: 俚语。也作 give someone a boost＝推一把。

meaning_en: a condition that destroys thinking and memory
quote: There clearly some dementia.
quote_cn: 他明显有痴呆。
example: Early dementia is often mistaken for ordinary forgetfulness.
example_cn: 早期痴呆常被当成普通的忘事。
note: 形容词 demented ＝ 疯的（俚语）。

meaning_en: thinking clearly and coherently
meaning_cn: 神志清楚的；表达清晰的
quote: He's not lucid.
quote_cn: 他已经不清醒了。
example: He had lucid moments but drifted in and out.
example_cn: 他有时清醒，有时又迷糊过去。
note: ≈ clear-headed。lucid dreaming＝清明梦。

meaning_en: a Spanish or Portuguese soap opera
quote: he was watching one of those telenovels
quote_cn: 他在看那种拉美肥皂剧。
example: Her mother watches a telenovela every afternoon.
example_cn: 她妈妈每天下午都看一部拉美剧。
note: 西语直接影响词。≈ soap opera。

meaning_en: honest and direct in expression
quote: you don't seem very forthright about this
quote_cn: 你在这件事上看起来不太坦率。
example: She gave a forthright answer that nobody wanted to hear.
example_cn: 她给了一个没人想听的坦率回答。
note: 近义 candid、frank。反义 evasive——本集正好两个都出现了。

meaning_en: something judged more important than the rest
quote: my life is not the priority here
quote_cn: 我的命在这儿不算最要紧的。
example: Once the outage was handled, security became the priority.
example_cn: 故障处理完之后，安全就变成了第一优先级。
note: take priority over／give priority to。形容词 top priority。

meaning_en: wanting more than one has or deserves
quote: Oh, you greedy old bastard.
quote_cn: 你这贪心的老混蛋。
example: He was greedy enough to ask for a raise and a promotion.
example_cn: 他贪到既要加薪又要升职。
note: 名词 greed。greedy for＝贪恋。

meaning_en: to move something illegally across a border
quote: My cousins are driving up here right now to smuggle us back
quote_cn: 我表哥们正开过来，要把我们偷运回去。
example: They were charged with smuggling wildlife products.
example_cn: 他们被控走私野生动物制品。
note: 名词 smuggler 走私者。smuggle sth across／in。

meaning_en: to give someone a reason to act
quote: He really tried to motivate him.
quote_cn: 他是真心想激励他。
example: Clear goals motivate people more than slogans do.
example_cn: 明确的目标比口号更能激励人。
note: 名词 motivation ＝ 动机／干劲。近义 spur on。

meaning_en: to single someone out for criticism
quote: Are you mad-dogging them, Tio?
quote_cn: 你在针对他们开火吗，Tio？
example: Reporters started mad-dogging the vendor all week.
example_cn: 记者们整周都在死咬那个供应商。
note: mad dog 本义「疯狗」。职场近义：lone voice ＝ 孤军奋战。

meaning_en: currently among the best-known or most successful
quote: On the hit parade, 1998.
quote_cn: 1998 年，正当红的时候。
example: Regional carriers are finally on the hit parade.
example_cn: 区域性的运营商终于也上了热门榜。
note: 原指歌曲排行榜。反义 also-ran ＝ 陪跑的。

meaning_en: to make the evidence hold up
quote: we couldn't make it stick
quote_cn: 但我们没法把这件事坐实。
example: Without a confession the case never made it stick.
example_cn: 没有口供，这案子一直立不住。
note: 刑侦语境。stick ＝ 站得住，证据／理论都可用。

meaning_en: to control things very strictly
quote: he runs a tight ship
quote_cn: 他管手下极严。
example: She runs a tight ship and nothing slips through.
example_cn: 她管得极严，一点岔子都不会漏。
note: 职场高频。反义 run things loosely。

meaning_en: real and genuine
quote: actual, honest-to-God evidence
quote_cn: 实打实的证据。
example: That's honest-to-God evidence, not a rumour.
example_cn: 那是实打实的证据，不是传闻。
note: 口语强调词。≈ for real。

meaning_en: hidden in a small enclosed place
quote: Found him tucked in the junkyard
quote_cn: 在废品场里找到了他。
example: The body was tucked in behind a false wall.
example_cn: 尸体被塞在一面假墙后面。
note: ＝ wedged。反义 tucked away（收拾起来）。

meaning_en: a good thing arrived ahead of schedule
meaning_cn: 圣诞提前到了；好事比预想来得早
quote: Christmas came early to the Schrader household.
quote_cn: 施拉德家提前过圣诞了。
example: A tax refund is Christmas coming early.
example_cn: 退税就像是圣诞提前到了。
note: ≈ Santa came early。职场也指「提前拿到好消息」。

meaning_en: time off work for your own life
quote: I gotta take some personal time.
quote_cn: 我得请几天私事假。
example: Employees get five days of personal time a year.
example_cn: 员工每年有五天事假。
note: 职场正式说法，≈ PTO。反义 billable time（可计费工时）。

meaning_en: to interrupt someone's time
quote: Really appreciate you sparing us your day off.
quote_cn: 真的感谢你抽出这一整天。
example: Thanks for sparing me ten minutes on Friday.
example_cn: 谢谢你周五抽十分钟给我。
note: 客气话。正面用：thanks for sparing me the time。

meaning_en: marks that make someone identifiable
quote: What about other distinguishing features?
quote_cn: 其他体貌特征呢？
example: The sketch lists three distinguishing features.
example_cn: 素描上列了三处辨认特征。
note: 形容词 distinguishing ＝ 有辨识度的。→ distinguish A from B。

meaning_en: too much to cover
quote: I don't know where to begin.
quote_cn: 我都不知道从哪儿说起。
example: There's so much to cover in an all-hands.
example_cn: 全员会上要讲的东西太多了。
note: 常接 at／on。也作 where to start。

meaning_en: nothing logged showing it happened
quote: No record of it.
quote_cn: 没有任何记录。
example: There's no record of the call on any carrier.
example_cn: 任何运营商都没有这次通话的记录。
note: 职场也常指「查无此人／无记录」。

meaning_en: to cling to any weak excuse
meaning_cn: 抓救命稻草；病急乱投医
quote: we're grasping at straws here.
quote_cn: 我们这是病急乱投医。
example: By March they were grasping at straws for a win.
example_cn: 到了三月他们抓住任何一点机会不放，指望能赢。
note: ＝ clutching at straws。desperate 义。

meaning_en: to give the message on to someone else
quote: Please pass along our best wishes.
quote_cn: 请代我们转达最好的祝愿。
example: She passed the feedback along without editorialising.
example_cn: 她把反馈原样转达了，没加评论。
note: ≈ pass on。反义 hold back（扣下不说）。

meaning_en: to connect them by phone or email
quote: if you could put me in touch with your son.
quote_cn: 如果你能帮我联系上你儿子。
example: Please put me in touch with whoever owns the account.
example_cn: 请帮我联系上这个客户的负责人。
note: 职场高频。＝ connect someone with。

meaning_en: to change the accepted account of past events
quote: We're gonna rewrite history with this.
quote_cn: 我们要用这个改写历史。
example: Don't rewrite history — publish the correction.
example_cn: 别改写历史，发个更正就行。
note: 职场也指「重新讲一遍当时发生了什么」。

meaning_en: to clear something out completely
quote: Time to clean the menudo out from between your ears.
quote_cn: 该把你耳朵里的牛杂掏干净了。
example: They clean out the archive every second year.
example_cn: 他们每两年把档案清一次。
note: clean out ＝ 清空／清走。clean up ＝ 收拾干净。

meaning_en: to do them a real favour
quote: do me a solid and check out a '89 Chevy Monte Carlo
quote_cn: 帮我个忙，查一下那辆 89 款雪佛兰。
example: Could you do me a solid and cover my shift Friday?
example_cn: 能帮我个忙，把周五的班替我上吗？
note: 俚语。a solid ＝ 一个真正的人情。

meaning_en: to volunteer for a disastrous job
quote: all sacrificial, jumping on a grenade, yo.
quote_cn: 像献祭一样往手雷上扑，老兄。
example: Whoever jumps on a grenade first will own the migration.
example_cn: 谁先抢下这颗雷，迁移这块就归他管。
note: 职场比喻。同类：hot potato、poison pill。

meaning_en: to die, or to fail as a business
quote: I don't want you to go belly up before we get there.
quote_cn: 我可不想你还没到就翻肚皮了。
example: Three of our suppliers went belly up last quarter.
example_cn: 上季度我们有三家供应商倒闭了。
note: 企业义比死亡义更常见。反过来 belly up ＝ 死了。

meaning_en: to strike them on the head
quote: You crack him over the head with something
quote_cn: 你拿东西朝他脑袋上砸。
example: He cracked the wasp nest over his head with a broom.
example_cn: 他拿扫帚把马蜂窝拍到了自己头上。
note: ＝ bonk／whack someone。

meaning_en: something visually attractive to look at
quote: dude needs his eye candy.
quote_cn: 老兄需要点养眼的。
example: They hired a designer purely as office eye candy.
example_cn: 他们请了个设计师，纯粹是为了养眼。
note: 略贬。职场也指「撑门面的人／项目」。

meaning_en: to be a sign of a good outcome
quote: they haven't found him yet bodes well.
quote_cn: 还没找到他，这算是个吉兆。
example: Flat forecasts bode well for the hiring plan.
example_cn: 持平的预测对招聘计划是个吉兆。
note: bode well／bode ill 反义。

meaning_en: a baby on the way
quote: you got a bun in the oven.
quote_cn: 你这是有喜了。
example: They announced a bun in the oven in December.
example_cn: 他们十二月宣布有喜了。
note: 婉辞。反义 empty oven ＝ 没有。

meaning_en: a car modified with hydraulics so it can bounce
quote: It's one of those jack-off low riders
quote_cn: 就是那种傻缺的改装低趴车。
example: The low riders were bouncing so hard the windows rattled.
example_cn: 那些低趴车弹得车窗都在响。
note: 1970 年代美式改装文化，源自墨西哥裔社区。动词 lowride。

meaning_en: to call or shout
quote: Holler if you need me.
quote_cn: 有事喊我。
example: Holler if anything looks off before we ship.
example_cn: 上线前要是看着哪儿不对就喊我。
note: 口语。近义 yell、shout。holler at someone ＝ 冲某人嚷。

meaning_en: within an acceptable tolerance
quote: That's close enough.
quote_cn: 差不多就行了。
example: If the numbers are within two percent, that's close enough.
example_cn: 数字在两个百分点以内就算差不多够了。
note: 常在再追问也没用时收口。＝ good enough。

meaning_en: to raise it and then abandon it
meaning_cn: 丢出来就不管了；半路撂挑子
quote: You can't just bring up secret cell phone and then drop it.
quote_cn: 你不能提了备用手机就不管了。
example: He raised the concern in the meeting and dropped it.
example_cn: 他在会上提了这个问题，然后就没下文了。
note: ＝ leave hanging。反义 follow through（跟到底）。

meaning_en: to relax; not rush
quote: Take it easy, Tio.
quote_cn: 放松点，Tio。
example: Take it easy — we have until Friday.
example_cn: 别急，我们还有到周五。
note: 既是真的「别紧张」，也常是敷衍安慰。

meaning_en: a long stretch of difficult work ahead
quote: We got a long ride ahead of us.
quote_cn: 我们前头还有很长的路要走。
example: With three rounds of review we had a long ride ahead.
example_cn: 还有三轮评审等着我们，前路不短。
note: 原指坐长途车。职场描述长周期项目。

meaning_en: that is the final arrangement
quote: That's the deal.
quote_cn: 我先吃。成交。
example: Two invoices in full or nothing — that's the deal.
example_cn: 两张发票全付，不然免谈——就这么定了。
note: 职场拍板用语。也作 what's the deal（怎么回事）。
